message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo (18 June 1815) was one of the bloodiest single-day engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  Roughly **47,000 soldiers** were killed, wounded, or taken prisoner in total:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| **French** | ~25,000 (including killed, wounded, missing) |
| **Allied (British, Dutch‑German, Prussian)** | ~22,000 |

These figures are based on contemporary reports and modern scholarship; exact numbers vary slightly among sources.
